# TEMT: Transportation Emission Measurement Tool

> TEMT is a freight emissions platform from IIM Bangalore. It calculates well-to-wheel greenhouse gas emissions for road, rail, air, sea and inland-waterway shipments in India with India-specific emission factors, following ISO 14083:2023, and produces GHG Protocol Scope 3 and SEBI BRSR Principle 6 reports. It is a product of the TCI–IIMB Supply Chain Sustainability Lab at IIM Bangalore.

Key facts:

- TEMT was the first platform in India certified to ISO 14083 (December 2024). Its information security is certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 by SGS.
- TEMT is adopted by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), and its emission factors API is integrated with the Unified Logistics Interface Platform (ULIP).
- The TCI–IIMB Supply Chain Sustainability Lab was founded in 2023 by Transport Corporation of India (TCI) and IIM Bangalore.
- TEMT is free to use in the browser without an account. Contact: https://www.iimb.ac.in/tci-supply-chain-sustainability-lab
